request: Compute the combined return proportion across both fictional depots and explain why averaging rates is wrong.
sources: Depot North received 10 items and returned 9; Depot South received 90 items and returned 45.
The requested overall proportion counts all returned items among all received items.
The depots handle different product types, and no cause of the difference is supplied.

expected.diagnostic: The unweighted average 70% treats unequal denominators equally.
